selection.distance: breadth-first hops on undirected source edges with transit barriers
selection.fanout: distinct full-source consumers; protected MM routes may pass
selection.effect_policy: Call-only mutable schema, FX-impure, nondeterministic tag, or explicit compiler RNG/state schema
selection.effects: Exclude effect calls before traversal; protection cannot cross them; results may become boundary inputs
selection.outputs: Keep escaping values with an internal matmul ancestor; DCE from those outputs only
selection.shape_interface: Coalesce typed shape values equal across every own config; preserve logical structure and settings

exact_structure.digest_policy: SHA-256 of ID-ordered graph data; node IDs are not canonical labels
exact_structure.matcher: Exact joint incidence color refinement, then VF2 on original directed graphs; verify original colors and ports

input_config_hash: SHA-256 of exact structure, retained settings and alias membership; first 8 hex digits
model_accounting: overlapping regions; excluded from disjoint model partition manifests

replay_interface.policy: typed shape specs equal across all retained captured points; no symbolic relation inferred
